title: 'See the N points' still leaves admin, and its back link goes to the participant chat
where: /admin/sessions/<code> Overview, open theme row -> 'See the N points', 1440px
what_happens: Still there from round 1 (the lane kept it as a stated decision in the PR). The link opens /s/<code>/points, the participant-side page: no admin nav, and its only back link ('← <code>') goes to the session chat, not back to the admin overview.

suggested_fix: Smallest: open the points link in a new tab (target=_blank) so the admin page stays put, or keep it as is and accept the browser-back return. An admin-side points view is its own change.
rule: established pattern: admin sub-pages (Synthesis, Logs) keep the admin bar and SessionHeader tabs
owners_call: Is leaving admin for the participant points page OK here, or should it open in a new tab?
